archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Premium Fintech

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' hybrid. Premium, authoritative, and clean.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Use p-8 or p-12 for containers.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_layout: Sidebar navigation with rounded cards and soft shadows. Content area uses p-6 or p-8.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense) for dashboards. Bento Grid for Landing Page features.

components.navigation: Sticky sidebar for dashboards (w-64). Glassmorphism sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) for the public landing page.
components.buttons: rounded-full or rounded-xl. Primary buttons use bg-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-600. Include hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all.
components.forms: Shadcn components, fully rounded inputs (rounded-xl), focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500. Use IBM Plex Sans for input text.
components.tables: Shadcn table, crisp borders, generous cell padding (p-4).
components.cards: Subtle roundness (rounded-2xl) and soft ambient shadow.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly define hover text and background.

image_urls.description: Abstract deep dark navy blue glowing mesh gradient for landing page hero.
Premium 3D mobile app mockup for the features section.
Business professional smiling for employer testimonial.
Female business professional for employee testimonial.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly apply data-testid to ALL interactive elements.
Landing page hero section must use the dark navy background (#0A1128) with white text, and 'hero_background' image overlapping with mix-blend-mode or low opacity overlay (bg-black/30).
Dashboard must be built with a permanent left sidebar.
Do not use Inter for headings. Use Outfit font.
Ensure all dashboard tables use Shadcn components and data points have high contrast.
Implement the three role-based dashboards (Admin, Employer, Employee) within separate route modules but sharing the same sidebar navigation shell style.
Use Phosphor icons or lucide-react for standard SaaS app icons.

Ensure the application layout strictly follows the requested 'premium fintech design with clean SaaS style: white/light dashboard, dark navy landing hero, blue primary color, rounded cards, soft shadows'.
